name: MOI SUBFRAME
description: Input timing diagnostics for sub-frame (CBF-style) research. Pass-through only: never alters inputs.

diagnostics.name: Input diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Measure when button events are applied inside a frame and flag duplicate / orphan / stuck inputs. Never changes input behavior. Also toggleable from the pause menu (SF: ON/OFF).

log-each-event.name: Log every event
log-each-event.description: Write each push/release to the Geode log (verbose).

report-on-quit.name: Report on level exit
report-on-quit.description: Write a timing summary to the Geode log when leaving a level.
